name: 53-realtime-message-counts
sql: select table_name, (xpath('/row/cnt/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as cnt from realtime.%I', table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint as row_count from information_schema.tables where table_schema='realtime' and table_name like 'messages_%' order by table_name
